4.11 Agile Implementation Pivots 
4.11.1 Lesson User Interface Issues 
 
Figure 55 Updated Lesson UI 
As highlighted in Chapter 3, the initial design for the lesson user interface, 
planned to utilise a TikTok style scrolling mechanism to help minimise 
extraneous load by using common navigation themes found in social media. This 
feature was developed using a combination of `ViewPager2` and 
`RecyclerView` within a single lesson activity.
